entries.name: ad-copywriter
entries.description: Use for paid ad copy — Meta (Facebook/Instagram), Google Ads (search and display), LinkedIn, X, TikTok, YouTube ads. Produces multiple variants per ad set, not creative direction.

entries.name: blog-post-writer
entries.description: Use for long-form blog posts — guides, tutorials, opinion pieces, comparison posts, listicles, case studies. Produces full drafts with H2/H3 structure. Use seo-meta-writer separately for meta tags.

entries.name: cmo-advisor
entries.description: Use when the user wants to think through a marketing strategy decision — channel mix, brand positioning, org structure, marketing OKRs, budget allocation, fractional-CMO-style strategic questions. Not for producing artifacts (use the artifact specialists for that).

entries.name: cold-outreach-copywriter
entries.description: Use for cold outreach — cold email prospecting, cold LinkedIn DMs, partnership intros, link-building emails. For first-touch only; use sales-email-writer for follow-ups inside an existing sequence.

entries.name: competitive-analyst
entries.description: Use for competitive research and analysis — competitor teardowns, feature comparisons, pricing-page audits, messaging audits, market-map building, win/loss synthesis. Produces analysis, not artifacts.

entries.name: content-strategist
entries.description: Use when the user wants to plan content — content calendars, pillar/cluster strategies, distribution plans, repurposing playbooks, editorial themes, brand voice guidelines. Strategic, not artifact-producing.

entries.name: growth-strategist
entries.description: Use when the user wants to design or audit a growth strategy — funnels, channels, growth loops, activation/retention/referral mechanics, north-star metrics, growth experiments. Strategic, not artifact-producing.

entries.name: landing-page-copywriter
entries.description: Use for landing page copy — full pages or specific sections (hero, features, social proof, FAQ, pricing, footer CTA). Produces copy with section structure, not visual design.

entries.name: newsletter-writer
entries.description: Use for newsletter editions — weekly roundups, founder updates, lifecycle newsletters, customer-facing product updates. Produces full editions, not subscription-funnel copy.

entries.name: positioning-coach
entries.description: Use when the user wants to nail positioning, messaging, ICP, value props, category, or competitive differentiation. Often the upstream problem when content "isn't landing." Strategic, not artifact-producing.

entries.name: press-release-writer
entries.description: Use for press releases — funding announcements, product launches, partnerships, hires, milestones. Produces a wire-ready release plus a journalist-friendly pitch email. Not for blog announcements (use blog-post-writer).

entries.name: sales-email-writer
entries.description: Use when the user needs a sales email, sales-email sequence, follow-up email, re-engagement email, or upsell/cross-sell email. Produces ready-to-send copy, not strategy.

entries.name: seo-meta-writer
entries.description: Use for SEO and social meta — title tags, meta descriptions, H1, OG/Twitter cards, schema-markup snippets, and slug suggestions. Use after content is drafted, not before.

entries.name: social-post-writer
entries.description: Use for organic social posts — LinkedIn, X/Twitter, Instagram captions, Threads, Bluesky. Produces platform-tuned posts, not paid-ad copy (use ad-copywriter for paid).

entries.name: video-script-writer
entries.description: Use for video scripts — YouTube long-form, YouTube Shorts, TikTok, Instagram Reels, sales videos, explainer videos, AI-generated video prompts (Sora, Veo, Runway). Produces a script with shot-level direction.
